name: @oge-ui/react-bpmn
description: React BPMN 2.0 editor from the OGE UI suite: palette click-then-place and drag-to-canvas, context pad connect/append, inline label editing, orthogonal routing, snapping with guides, pools and lanes, boundary events, sub-processes, a properties panel, minimap, element search, align/distribute, clipboard, snapshot undo/redo, BPMN XML + JSON + SVG import/export, overlays and a keyboard-accessible canvas — running the same framework-free engine and editor core (@oge-ui/bpmn-engine) and the same stylesheet as the Angular editor. No watermark. Source-available commercial license (free for evaluation and development).
author: kaya2m
